**AIM**  

The aim of this study is to investigate whether a student's faculty of study has an effect on the time required to solve a standardised logical   reasoning test. The study will compare the average problem-solving times of students from different faculties using a one-way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA).


**RESEARCH QUESTION**  

  Does faculty of study influence the average time taken by Stellenbosch University students to solve a standardised logical reasoning test?


# Experimental design


**EXPERIMENTAL UNITS**  


  The experimental units are individual undergraduate students currently enrolled at Stellenbosch University

**FACTOR (Independent Variable)**  


  Faculty of Study


**TREATMENT LEVELS**  

  Engineering
  Science
  Economic and Management Sciences (EMS)

**RESPONSE VARIABLES**  


  The total time (in seconds) required to complete a standardised logical reasoning test.

**REPLICATION**  


  Ten students will be recruited from each faculty, giving a total sample size of thirty(30) participants.
